findings.title: Browser tabs nest a close button inside a role-tab container
findings.trigger: A closable browser tab is present and a keyboard or screen-reader user navigates the tablist.
findings.actual: A focusable div with role=tab and custom Enter/Space/arrow handling contains a native close button, creating nested interactive semantics and an inconsistent roving-tab-stop model.
findings.expected: Each tab has one coherent tab interaction and a separately reachable close action with predictable focus behavior.
findings.smallestFix: Make the tab and close control sibling owned controls, preserving one roving tab stop for tabs and a separately named close action.

findings.title: Custom radio groups lack arrow-key navigation and roving focus
findings.trigger: A keyboard user focuses a language, interaction-mode, or zero-risk model choice and presses an arrow key.
findings.actual: Each role=radio is a default-tab-stop button and no group handles arrow/Home/End navigation.
findings.expected: One radio is tabbable and arrow keys move focus and selection within the group.
findings.smallestFix: Use native radio inputs or implement the APG roving-tabindex radio pattern.

findings.title: Expanded MCP tutorial dialog does not contain or restore focus
findings.trigger: The user expands the MCP guide video, tabs through controls, or closes it with Escape.
findings.actual: The dialog uses aria-modal and autoFocus on close, but has no focus trap, inert background, opener ref, or focus restoration.
findings.expected: Focus enters and stays in the modal, Escape closes it, and focus returns to the expand button.
findings.smallestFix: Add dialog focus containment, retain the opener ref, restore focus on close, and expose a labelled heading via aria-labelledby.

findings.title: Verified account remains actionable instead of read-only
findings.trigger: An account is authenticated and its account and connector checks are complete; the user returns to the account card.
findings.actual: Sign in remains enabled, and Check and Check connector remain available outside manual mode even when the corresponding success flags are true; no explicit replace/edit/upgrade unlock exists.
findings.expected: Completed controls are read-only/disabled and only one explicit Replace/Edit/Upgrade action can re-enter the flow.
findings.smallestFix: Derive a completed locked state, disable or relabel completed actions, and add one explicit replace/edit/upgrade transition.

rejected.reason: Technical compatibility identifiers were excluded as instructed; no branding defect was established.
Only reachable keyboard, screen-reader, form-state, error-state, or transition defects were retained.

Capacity field has label, invalid state, description, and live status feedback.
Result, retry, and failure paths expose status or alert semantics.
MCP wizard and form layout includes responsive wrapping, visible focus, readable sizing, and error styling.
